title: Clearphase
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -9 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Original 128-second stereo melodic trance instrumental at fixed 144 BPM in 4/4. Begin with a full energetic chorus: strong four-on-the-floor kick, clap on two and four, clean hats, rolling bass, warm suspended chords and a distinct short plucked arpeggio attack on every quarter beat. Signature melody is a six-note ascending contour with a two-note descending reply; invert the reply and change chord roots after 64 seconds while maintaining the same drum and bass level. Continuous clear beat and hook through every 8-second interval to the final beat. Luminous uplifting family-friendly electronic music. No intro, build, breakdown, fade, silent tail, tempo drift, abrasive distortion, vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation.
